description:
From ISS-001 (d854fea) and ISS-006. User 2026-10-20: own findings must keep blocking, but an agent must never get stuck completely.

Fix: keep the stall release. A fingerprint that holds an own finding releases only after 5 identical Stops (named constant), not 2. On release the system message lists the unfixed own findings for the user, and the ledger stop_stall row marks them as own. Inherited-only fingerprints keep the limit of 2. Update README "Repeat limit" and CHANGELOG.

Acceptance: own finding blocks Stops 1-5 and releases on 6 with the list shown; inherited-only releases on 3. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Raise the Stop release limit for the agent's own unfixed findings
